name: Verify SSD health
command: set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@clementine.whatbox.ca 'sleep 12; podman ps --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}"; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:12346/api/health'
description: Verify Clementine’s restarted SSD client after startup completes.
